mechanism_narrative: The four-week upward trend in TRANSIT and WORKPLACES from t-3w to t-0w signals removal of mobility constraints; as commuting and transit use recover, weekday retail-and-recreation footfall rises over the next four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT rose from -24.1 to -15.7 and WORKPLACES rose from -20.0 to -14.3 over four weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is not higher than over the last 28 days when TRANSIT and WORKPLACES both rose over the prior four weeks.

mechanism_narrative: A PARKS crossing from negative to positive reflects a behavioral shift toward outdoor leisure that broadens into discretionary retail trips; the crossing above zero predicts higher RETAIL_REC over the following two weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS moved from -9.3 to 8.4 between t-3w and t-1w
failure_condition: When PARKS crosses from <= 0 to > 0, RETAIL_REC over the next 14 days is lower than or equal to its prior 14-day mean.

mechanism_narrative: Under reopening with RESIDENTIAL below 5 and falling, stay-at-home behavior weakens and discretionary trips rise; this policy-linked shift raises RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:RESIDENTIAL fell from 7.4 to 3.7 over four weeks
failure_condition: In reopening weeks with RESIDENTIAL < 5.0, RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is lower than over the last 28 days.

mechanism_narrative: The interaction of positive GROCERY_PHARM and positive PARKS indicates simultaneous errand and leisure activity; when both are positive, retail-and-recreation visits rise over the next two weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:GROCERY_PHARM and PARKS were both positive in t-2w and t-1w
failure_condition: When GROCERY_PHARM > 0 and PARKS > 0, RETAIL_REC over the next 14 days is lower than or equal to its prior 14-day mean.

mechanism_narrative: The recent PARKS decline from 8.4 to 4.7 while RESIDENTIAL remains positive signals fading out-of-home activity; this drags RETAIL_REC lower over the next two weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS fell from 8.4 to 4.7 and RESIDENTIAL remained positive at 3.7
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 14 days is higher than or equal to its prior 14-day mean despite PARKS falling and RESIDENTIAL staying positive.

mechanism_narrative: A TRANSIT weekly mean below -15.0 signals continued avoidance of public transport and restricts retail catchments; this predicts lower RETAIL_REC over the next week.
failure_condition: When TRANSIT < -15.0, RETAIL_REC over the next 7 days is higher than or equal to its prior 7-day mean.

mechanism_narrative: Seasonal spring conditions raise both PARKS and grocery errand activity; the interaction of PARKS > 0 and GROCERY_PHARM > 5 lifts retail-and-recreation mobility over the next four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS was 4.7 and GROCERY_PHARM was 9.0 at t-0w
failure_condition: When PARKS > 0 and GROCERY_PHARM > 5, RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is not higher than over the last 28 days.

mechanism_narrative: In a regime of workplace restrictions, WORKPLACES remaining below -14.0 suppresses commuter-linked retail spending; this predicts lower RETAIL_REC over the next week.
failure_condition: When WORKPLACES < -14.0, RETAIL_REC over the next 7 days is higher than or equal to its prior 7-day mean.
